entities.summary: The Kelly Family is a European-American music group consisting of a multi-generational family, usually nine siblings who were joined occasionally on stage in their earlier years by their parents. They play a repertoire of rock, pop, and folk music, and sing in English, Spanish, German, and Basque. The group had chart and concert success around the world, predominantly in continental Europe—mainly in Germany, the Benelux countries, Scandinavia, the Czech Republic, Poland, Slovakia, Spain, and Portugal—and some in Ireland.
